notes.title: Monster Girl Jungle Released!
notes.content: [h1]Game is released![/h1][p]I hope everyone enjoys my new project.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557720/Monster_Girl_Jungle"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo vs Version 0.1 – Content Overview[/h2][h3]This update includes a substantial expansion of content and features:[/h3][p]Word Count: 6,533 → 33,219 words[/p][p]H-Scenes: 2 → 20[/p][p](Certain types of content scenes not included in this count)[/p][p]New Minigame[/p][p]Updated UI[/p][p]Expanded Gallery[/p][p]Achievements Added[/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][p]Translation Improvements[/p][p]Performance Enhancements[/p][p]Lovense Support Added[/p]
